name: worktrees
description: Gives every agent that can edit a git worktree of its own, runs a project's setup script with its own port range, kills what an agent left running, and removes worktrees and branches once their PR has merged

readOnlyAgents.title: More read-only agent types
readOnlyAgents.description: Comma-separated agent types that never edit files and so run without a worktree, on top of Explore, Plan, claude-code-guide, statusline-setup, scout and reviewer.

portBase.title: Port base
portBase.description: Worktree slot N owns ports portBase + N*10 through portBase + N*10 + 9. Slots start at 1, so portBase..portBase+9 stay free for the main checkout.

tidyOnStart.title: Tidy merged branches at session start
tidyOnStart.description: In the background at session start, remove worktrees and branches (local and remote) whose PR has merged, and stop processes left in deleted worktrees. /tidy does the same on demand.
